matches.rationale: Neither finding identifies the ground-truth defect: the failure of Jacobian algebras to have the required Ext-symmetry, or generalized preprojective algebras failing to be Jacobian. Pred 1 concerns a product-index-range error in §4.1, and Pred 2 concerns a domain/arrow-direction issue in Definition 2.2; both are different defects under R1/R4.

pred_verdicts.rationale: It reports a concrete index-range error in §4.1, which is not the ground-truth Jacobian/Ext-symmetry defect.
It reports a concrete domain/arrow-direction inconsistency in Definition 2.2, which is not the ground-truth defect.
